name: nose-short-film
description: D235's second graft film: a short grafted nose, not evolved. D178's ten founders (rounds/nursery/pools/410a70db44a4b20a.tsv), each with a nose grafted by NoseGraft (Evosim.Nursery --graft-nose --anchor 0,0.6,-1 --axis 0,0,-1 --area 0.0288 --slenderness 1.5): a box 6 by 6 by 9 cm (half-extents 0.03, 0.03, 0.045), area 0.0288 m2, on the root's front face 9 cm above its centre and clear of the mouth at the face's centre, pointing along -z, the way these bodies swim, unturned so the direction sense keeps the root's frame, on a fixed joint, every leaf-smell link moved onto it with weights summed. Its area law gives 1.9 times the first graft's smell noise and 5.2 times its direction noise. Everything else is nose-graft-film's: swum as the bench swims a pool, every brain as written, four to a tank (4, 4 and 2), for 300 s in leaf-direction-patches-s2-w5's patchy tank and its world, the round-60 world, config 3a95d053dd97082d as there, the same exam and salt, so nose-graft-film-baseline pairs with it too. A film and nothing scored: the bodies were bred to whole-body smell, not to a nose. The pool, 06c9b91ce9a3d835, is what --graft-nose wrote from 410a70db44a4b20a.
